build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with static bars and a dynamic ball using creator_lib
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable angle, position, and scale in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball placed at the top of the scene with configurable horizontal position
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the lower bar using SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.PRE_TWO_BALLS for difficulty classification
